title: Erasure Skew and Retrieval Capital: the metadata-packet query battery
description: These forecasts come from the metadata packets for Retrieval Capital and the Erasure Skew Coefficient. Each names a query and what a composition surface should return within a stated horizon of three to eighteen months: that retrieval capital is the standing that predicts which sources survive, that it is distinct from its homophone recovery capital, and that Omega is the covariance of retention with retrieval capital.
